PerfectCurse:Plague.TITLE: Plague
PerfectCurse:Plague.DESCRIPTION: At end of turn, if this is in your hand, gain {PoisonPower} Poison.

PerfectCurse:Rot.TITLE: Rot
PerfectCurse:Rot.DESCRIPTION: While in hand, all cards in your hand temporarily lose their upgrades.

PerfectCurse:OldWound.TITLE: Old Wound
PerfectCurse:OldWound.DESCRIPTION: While in hand, lose {Damage} HP whenever you play a card.

PerfectCurse:Shackles.TITLE: Shackles
PerfectCurse:Shackles.DESCRIPTION: While in hand, take {Damage} damage whenever you play a card.

PerfectCurse:Shortage.TITLE: Shortage
PerfectCurse:Shortage.DESCRIPTION: Eternal. At end of turn, if this is in your hand, draw 2 fewer cards next turn.

PerfectCurse:CurseBlood.TITLE: Curse Blood
PerfectCurse:CurseBlood.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you draw a Curse, gain #b{StrengthGain} Strength.

PerfectCurse:StarlightAegis.TITLE: Starlight Aegis
PerfectCurse:StarlightAegis.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you draw a Curse, gain #b{Block} Block.

PerfectCurse:UnexpectedDefect.TITLE: Unexpected Defect
PerfectCurse:UnexpectedDefect.DESCRIPTION: Gain #b{Block} Block. Gain #b{EnergyGain} Energy. Draw #b{Draw} card(s). Add #b{CurseCount} random Curses to your hand.

PerfectCurse:RideThePoison.TITLE: Ride the Poison
PerfectCurse:RideThePoison.DESCRIPTION: Innate. Whenever you draw a Curse, immediately trigger its negative effect and Exhaust it, then apply #b{Poison} Poison to ALL enemies.

PerfectCurse:ReinforcedSmelting.TITLE: Reinforced Smelting
PerfectCurse:ReinforcedSmelting.DESCRIPTION: Deal #b{Damage} damage. Draw #b{Draw} card(s). You may Exhaust a Curse from your hand, draw pile, or discard pile. If you do, repeat these effects.

PerfectCurse:MaliciousInfusion.TITLE: Malicious Infusion
PerfectCurse:MaliciousInfusion.DESCRIPTION: Summon #b{Summon}. You may Exhaust a Curse from your hand. If you do, Summon #b{Summon} at the start of your next turn.

PerfectCurse:Lust.TITLE: Lust
PerfectCurse:Lust.DESCRIPTION: While this is in your hand, you cannot play Attacks.

PerfectCurse:Prejudice.TITLE: Prejudice
PerfectCurse:Prejudice.DESCRIPTION: While this is in your hand, you cannot play Skills.

PerfectCurse:Amnesia.TITLE: Amnesia
PerfectCurse:Amnesia.DESCRIPTION: While this is in your hand, you cannot play Powers.

PerfectCurse:Brutality.TITLE: Brutality
PerfectCurse:Brutality.DESCRIPTION: Innate. Retain. While this is in your hand, you cannot gain Block.
